articles.title: U.S. and Canada in a Big Trade Fight: No More Cheese or Motorcycles?
articles.summary: The U.S. is banning Canadian dairy, alcohol, and motorcycles. This is part of a big trade war. Canada is fighting back with its own taxes on U.S. goods.

articles.title: Police Investigate Reform UK Over Big Donation Trick
articles.summary: Police are looking into Reform UK, a British political party, for possibly breaking rules about foreign money. A secret recording showed aides suggesting a way to get a big donation.

articles.title: Big Race in New Hampshire: Sununu vs. Pappas for Senate
articles.summary: Two famous names are competing for a U.S. Senate seat in New Hampshire. John Sununu and Chris Pappas won their primaries and will face off in November.
